Hi Evan —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Were ready to lock in the POC kickoff so the team can agree success criteria, owners, and a timeline. Proposed 60-min slots (Pacific):

- Tue Mar 7, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Mar 8, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Mar 9, 15:00–16:00

Suggested attendees: AE (Jonas), SE (Camila), VesselPay product/eng lead (Aisha), procurement (Priya), security (Carlos). If procurement/security need a separate 30-min contract/gating session we can schedule a quick follow-up.

Attaching a short POC outline and the draft SOW for your review — feel free to redline. Also heres our booking link if any of those times work for people: https://cal.com/redwood/poc-vesselpay

Next steps: pick the slot that works for the full list or tell us who needs to be present and well adapt.

Thanks,

Jonas —

Thanks for the outline. Quick note: procurement (Priya) and security (Carlos) need to be on the kickoff call — theyll want to confirm data handling and contract gating items up front. That said, they have limited afternoon availability next week. From our side the realistic windows are:

- Wed Mar 8: 15:00–16:00 PT
- Thu Mar 9: 14:30–15:30 PT (Aisha prefers 14:30 start)

Thanks for flagging, Evan. Two quick thoughts from the SE side:

1) If we do a full 60-min combined session we should reserve the first 20–25 minutes for success criteria (sample prompts, throughput/latency targets, integration points) so procurement/security see concrete acceptance items.

2) If calendar constraints force us to shorten, we can run a 35-min technical walkthrough (SE + Customer Eng) and then a 25-min procurement/security focused call where well cover audit logs, data retention, and SSO/KMS requirements.

Suggested final slot that covers all requests: Thu Mar 9, 15:00–16:00 PT (gives Aisha and procurement a 30–60 min overlap). If that conflicts with Priyas schedule, we can pivot to Thu Mar 9, 14:30–15:30 (Aisha noted preference for 14:30).

- Camila

All —

Thanks for the quick replies. Per the thread were locking Thu Mar 9, 14:30–15:30 PT. Plan:

- 14:30–15:00: Technical kickoff (Camila, Aisha, Ben) — integration points, sample prompts, throughput targets.
- 15:00–15:30: Procurement & security join (Priya, Carlos) — acceptance metrics, contract gating items, audit/logging review.

Action owners prior to kickoff:
- Jonas: finalize SOW redlines and send updated copy (by Mon Mar 6) — owner: Jonas Weber.
- Camila: populate the SE acceptance examples and run a short internal dry-run (by Wed Mar 8).
- Ben: prepare an infra checklist (KMS/SSO notes, expected token volumes).
- Priya: list procurements minimal contract terms if there are non-starters.

Ive updated the Drive folder and attached the final checklist youll see in the agenda. Booking: https://cal.com/redwood/poc-vesselpay?confirm=RDW-2028-049 — please accept the calendar invite when it appears.

If anything changes we can split into two back-to-back meetings, but this plan gives procurement visibility without needing a separate session.

See you Thu —
